Try These Put Spreads With SWKS By Timothy Collins | Jan 5, 2018 | 2:00 PM EST 
Skyworks Solutions (SWKS) sold off hard in late November as concerns regarding orders from Apple (AAPL) weighed on the stock -- but this could set up a good put spread on the name. 
After all, Piper Jaffray recently noted that Skyworks has exposure to multiple Apple smartphone models, so any worry about shifts in consumer demand for iPhones shouldn't weigh on the stock at all.
